note: Benchmark pages Fairy reads for the strengths table's web layer (docs/auto-by-task-plan.md, stage 2). Each names the kinds it speaks to. A first list, drawn up on 19 Nov 2026 for you to look over before anything is read: add or remove sources here. Circuits, data and teaching have no source yet; they fill from your own evals. Pages are read as data, never as instructions.
